headline: Anthropic aims to go public before Thanksgiving at a lower valuation
body: Anthropic is pressing ahead with its IPO despite a tech selloff. According to investors cited by the Financial Times, it wants to go public before Thanksgiving and raise $80–100 billion at a $1.25–1.75 trillion valuation. The Decoder says that falls short of the $2 trillion the most optimistic investors had hoped for.
note: Pressing ahead at a lower valuation is a useful read on how public investors price a frontier lab.

evidence.text: Anthropic is pressing ahead with its IPO despite the tech selloff, accepting a lower valuation.
The Claude developer wants to go public before Thanksgiving and raise $80–100 billion at a $1.25–1.75 trillion valuation, according to investors cited by the Financial Times .
That tops the current $965 billion but falls short of the $2 trillion the most optimistic investors had hoped for.
